test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which are the most widespread forests in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Tropical Deciduous Forests__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Tropical Deciduous Forests:

__
 
• They are the most widespread in India.
 
• They are also called monsoon forests.
 
• They spread over regions that receive rainfall between 70-200 cm.
 
• Based on the availability of water, these forests are further divided into moist and dry deciduous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tropical Evergreen Forests are found in warm and humid areas with annual precipitation of over 200 cm and a mean annual temperature above 22°C.
 
• Mountain forests can be defined as forests
 
 
• On land with an elevation of 2500 m above sea level or higher, irrespective of the slope, or
 
• On land with an elevation of 300–2500 m and a slope with sharp changes in elevation within a short distance.
 
 
 
• Mangrove forests are productive wetlands that occur in coastal intertidal zones.
